run_image_qa_multimodal: run the image_qa function to answer a question using two input images via Gemini multimodal model
create_function_image_qa: create a decorated sgl.function that accepts two image files and a question for multimodal QA
build_multimodal_user_message: build a user message with two images and a text question using sgl.user and sgl.image
generate_assistant_answer: generate an assistant response with max_tokens limit using sgl.gen in a multimodal conversation
set_vertexai_backend: set the default SGLang backend to VertexAI with the gemini-pro-vision model
